title: Final: async in practice
cards/0/task: Load the three page sections as fast as you can.
cards/1/q: What does an async method return to its caller at its first real pause?
cards/1/explain: The result comes later, through that task.
cards/2/explain: UploadAsync isn't an event handler; it needs async Task.
cards/3/q: catch (HttpRequestException) around task.Result. Will it catch?
cards/4/task: Show that WhenAll collects every error: make at least two tasks fail.
cards/5/q: Which are true about cancellation? Select all that apply.
cards/5/options/0: You must pass it all the way down, into every async method
cards/5/options/1: A long loop must check the token itself
cards/5/options/3: Awaiting a canceled task throws OperationCanceledException
cards/5/explain: Nothing gets killed: code stops where it checks the token. A canceled task goes into the Canceled state, and the exception is thrown by awaiting it.
cards/6/explain: WhenAny returns the winning task; one more await collects its result.
cards/7/options/0: The method is called very often and the result is usually ready at once
cards/7/options/1: The method always waits a long time on the network
cards/7/explain: The savings are on the fast path with no waiting.
